newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Menem seeks impeachment of labor judge.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Menem seeks impeachment of labor judge.

text.p: Argentine President Carlos Menem said Saturday he will ask Congress to determine whether a judge who ruled that Menem violated the Constitution with three labor reform decrees should be impeached.
"His ruling is a kind of satire," Menem told journalists in his native province of La Rioja, 700 miles (1,200 kilometers) northwest of Buenos Aires.
Menem said he will file charges against Judge Julio Garcia Martinez in the Lower Chamber of Congress to determine if an impeachment should proceed.
Cabinet Chief Jorge Rodriguez said Garcia's ruling was "plagued with irregularities" and the "decrees ruled by the executive will remain in place."

Judge Garcia Martinez's ruling said the decrees established by Menem in December "have transgressed, modified and violated article 14 of the National Constitution," which guarantees union coordination of collective wage talks.
